applyTo: "**/*.cs"

Use decimal arithmetic for currency. Review inclusive bounds and the exact
6-to-7-night and 13-to-14-night discount transitions. At 14 nights, the 15%
discount replaces rather than stacks with the 10% weekly discount.
Preserve ArgumentOutOfRangeException parameter
names. Prefer focused changes; no formatting-only review findings. Any review
finding should identify a concrete failing input and expected behavior.
